text: でも　つかまえられれば　たよりに　なる　ポケモンだよ

structure.jp: たよりに　なる　ポケモンだよ
structure.en: it's a Pokémon you can rely on

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending means 'if'. Here it is on つかまえられる 'can catch'. つかまえられれば = 'if you can catch one'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb says you are able to do it. つかまえる 'catch' becomes つかまえられる = 'can catch'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たよりに　なる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. たよりに　なる　ポケモン = 'a Pokémon you can rely on'.
